fact: Kwenda established the foundations of the single social registry (CSU) by linking the Kwenda MIS to MASFAMU's integrated beneficiary registry SIGAS, but the systems have limited interoperability and SIGAS cannot collate Kwenda household data; the Kwenda MIS is to be made interoperable with the CSU.
title: Enhancing the Social Protection System for Human Capital and Resilience Project (Project Appraisal Document)
